NDA-covered · industry-labeled · Managed Nov 2025 to Mar 2026 · Islamabad-based engagement

Starting a B2B social presence from scratch

I set up the accounts, built a content plan and managed an ad campaign that reported 65 inbound calls. The call quality and sales impact have not been verified.

My role

I set up the social accounts, planned the content and creatives, wrote the copy and ran the Meta campaign.

Sector

B2B industrial · Elevator manufacturer & supplier

Status

Case study / reported evidence

Topics

B2B industrial · Lead generation · Built from zero

01 / Starting point

The challenge

The company had no social media accounts or existing content to work with. I needed to find a way to show what the business actually did and reach people involved in construction and property development.

The insight

Real installations make better evidence than broad promises. Showing an elevator already installed in a building gives potential buyers something concrete to assess.

02 / The approach

The plan

  • Set up the social accounts properly before publishing.
  • Look at how other industrial businesses explain technical products and adapt the ideas for this brand.
  • Show a real installed elevator in the ad so potential customers can see an actual example of the work.
03 / Execution

Make the rhythm visible.

Getting started

I created the accounts, secured them with two-step verification and completed the profiles.

Organic content

I planned the content and directed the creatives. The client later reported appearing among the top search results for its name, although that ranking has not been independently checked.

Meta campaign

I wrote the ad, planned the audience and ran a campaign aimed at decision makers in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Gujranwala and Lahore.

06 / Selected proof

A closer look at the work.

These examples include dates and sources so you can see what they show and what they do not.

04 / Results

Evidence with the label still attached.

The client portfolio reports 65 inbound calls at PKR 276 per call. The account reports also show 5,374 organic Instagram views in November to December, 2,539 in December to January, and 5,406 organic Facebook views in December to January. The calls have not been verified as qualified leads or sales. Those are different outcomes.

05 / Reflection

What stays after the campaign?

This was a good example of starting with very little and building a usable content and advertising plan. The reported calls are encouraging, but they should not be confused with confirmed orders.

Credits
My contribution: strategy, content planning, creative direction and Meta Ads management. The client remains anonymous under an NDA.
